meta.name: solidity-security
meta.description: Master smart contract security best practices to prevent common vulnerabilities and implement secure Solidity patterns. Use when writing smart contracts, auditing existing contracts, or implementing security measures for blockchain applications.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出防御常见漏洞的智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在编写或审计区块链合约,担心出现安全漏洞
copy.tagline_en: Write smart contracts that resist common security exploits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are writing or auditing blockchain contracts and worry about vulnerabilities

howto.what: 面对智能合约任务时,会给出防重入、防溢出、访问控制等安全写法;细节不足会查 references/details.md;审计准备会展示带注释且遵循 CEI(先检查、改状态、后交互)的示例代码。
howto.when: 当用户编写或审计智能合约,或为区块链应用添加安全防护时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这段合约有没有重入漏洞
say.note: Claude 会分析合约的重入风险并指出问题。

say.text: 把这段 Solidity 改成遵循 CEI 的模式
say.note: Claude 会按先检查、改状态、再交互的顺序改写。

say.text: 给我补一个防整数溢出的 Hardhat 测试
say.note: Claude 会按要求生成对应测试代码。

howto.what_en: Guides Solidity security: when handling smart contracts, suggests reentrancy, overflow, and access-control defenses; reads references/details.md for deeper detail; audit prep shows documented CEI (checks-effects-interactions) examples.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user is writing or auditing smart contracts, or requests security measures for blockchain applications.

say_en.text: Check this contract for reentrancy vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes the contract and flags reentrancy risks.

say_en.text: Refactor this Solidity code to follow the CEI pattern.
say_en.note: Claude rewrites it in checks-effects-interactions order.

say_en.text: Add a Hardhat test to prevent integer overflow.
say_en.note: Claude generates the corresponding test code.
